数据与许可

查看或获取本版本的完整源码。原创程序使用 GNU AGPL v3（仅第 3 版）。第三方数据仍受各自条款约束。

  • 海岸线：Made with Natural Earth，1:50m Land，公有领域。
  • 全球与区域高程：Mapzen / Tilezen Terrain Tiles。本项目将 Terrarium 瓦片转换为米制整型网格；详见完整提供方署名与许可说明。
  • 月平均海温和高空风来自 NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory，Boulder, Colorado, USA（NOAA PSL）：ERSSTv5 和 NCEP/NCAR 再分析的 1991–2020 气候平均值，已重新采样。模拟的天气变化不是 NOAA 预报。
  • 红外显示中的 BW、BD 和 RBTOP 为本地数值色标，参考 Dapiya 云图图例；这里没有转发其实况影像。

Data & license

Get the complete source code. Original software is licensed under the GNU AGPL, version 3 only. Third-party data retain their upstream terms.

  • Coastlines: Made with Natural Earth. 1:50m Land, public domain.
  • Global and regional elevation: Mapzen / Tilezen Terrain Tiles, converted from Terrarium tiles to integer metre grids. See all providers and original notices.
  • Sea temperatures and upper-air winds: ERSSTv5 and NCEP/NCAR reanalysis (1991–2020 normals), supplied by the NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory, Boulder, Colorado, USA. Fields have been resampled; the simulation is not a NOAA forecast.
  • BW, BD and RBTOP use local enhancement curves informed by Dapiya legends. No live satellite imagery is redistributed.
